headline: ChatGPT adds a native GIF maker
dek: Images 2.6 creates and edits animations in the chat itself, per Canaltech.

s2.label: What happened
s2.title: Images 2.6
body: OpenAI launched Images 2.6 and gave ChatGPT the ability to create and edit GIFs in chat, per Canaltech, Tecmundo and Olhar Digital.
Just describe the GIF or upload a photo to animate.

s4.label: Why it matters
s4.title: Faster
body: OpenAI says the model generates images 50% faster, per Tecmundo and Canaltech.
Users create over 4 billion images a week, says the company (Tecmundo).

caption.hook: ChatGPT GIF creation is here: it now makes and edits animated GIFs in the chat, with Images 2.6.
body: Per Canaltech, Tecmundo and Olhar Digital, users just describe the GIF or upload a photo. Then they can adjust speed, view frames and resize the file, something ChatGPT could not do natively before. The tool is built into the chat itself, so no separate app is needed.

OpenAI says the model generates images 50% faster, per Tecmundo. Two models reach the API, Flare and Sunburst. The feature covers all plans, with a gradual rollout, so it may not show up in every account yet.
caption.cta: Would you use ChatGPT to make GIFs?
